gen.title: Standard layered model by altitude
gen.orderNote: Presented in increasing altitude as shown in the model

steps.label: three zones
steps.quote: The model has three zones with separate curve fits for the troposphere, the lower stratosphere, and the upper stratosphere.

steps.label: troposphere
steps.quote: The troposphere runs from the surface of the Earth to 36,152 feet.

steps.label: temperature decreases linearly
steps.quote: In the troposphere, the temperature decreases linearly and the pressure decreases exponentially.

steps.label: lower stratosphere
steps.quote: The lower stratosphere runs from 36,152 feet to 82,345 feet.

steps.label: temperature is constant
steps.quote: In the lower stratosphere the temperature is constant and the pressure decreases exponentially.

steps.label: temperature increases slightly
steps.quote: In the upper stratosphere the temperature increases slightly, and the pressure decreases exponentially.
